visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a tight close-up of a pair of hands vigorously scrubbing a white cloth with a yellowish stain. A creamy, white substance is applied to the fabric, and the hands use a circular motion to work it in. Yellow variety-show style text appears over the hands. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of a man with long, dark hair looking down with an expression of intense surprise and delight. He is wearing a black shirt and a silver necklace with a small pendant. The background is slightly blurred but appears to be a residential indoor setting. (3) The man is now seated on a grey sofa in a living room, holding a smartphone in one hand and a blue tube of SENKA facial cleanser in the other. He speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions, pointing at the screen of his phone. (4) The scene shifts to a kitchen environment where a dirty stainless steel gas stove is shown. A small circular inset shows the man's face as he talks. He then applies the blue facial cleanser directly onto the greasy surface of the stove. (5) A hand holding a paper towel wipes away the white cream from the stove, revealing a clean, shiny surface underneath. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the contrast between the dirty and clean areas. (6) A before-and-after split-screen comparison is displayed, showing the dramatic transformation of the stove. The man is seen in the kitchen, reacting with high energy, holding a roll of paper towels and looking amazed. (7) The man demonstrates cleaning a white t-shirt stained with red sauce. He squeezes the cleanser onto the stain and rubs it with his fingers. The camera uses a high-angle shot to focus on the hands and the fabric on a wooden table. (8) The shirt is then shown being rinsed under a running faucet in a white bathroom sink. The water washes away the suds, and the stain appears to have vanished. (9) In a bathroom, the man holds two tubes of cleanser: one blue and one white/purple. He points to a dirty toilet bowl with visible mineral scale. (10) The white cleanser is applied to the interior of the toilet, and a white brush is used to scrub the surface. A split-screen shows the toilet before and after the cleaning process, looking significantly whiter. (11) The video concludes with the man back in a sitting position, holding the products and speaking to the camera with a satisfied smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, high-pitched male exclamation "Oh!" followed immediately by a sharp, percussive hit SFX. An upbeat electronic dance music track with a strong, driving beat and synthesizer layers begins. (2) A male voice speaks rapidly with high energy and an enthusiastic tone, narrating his discovery. The speech is clear and articulate, with frequent rising intonations indicating excitement. (3) A sequence of transition whooshes and sharp impact SFX punctuate the narration as the scene changes to the kitchen. A wet, scrubbing sound is heard as he demonstrates the cleaning. (4) The man screams "Oh!" again with high arousal, followed by boisterous laughter. The music continues at a consistent tempo, maintaining the high energy of the presentation. (5) A watery splashing sound is heard as he rinses the fabric in the sink, accompanied by a brief stinger SFX to emphasize the result. (6) The male narrator's tone becomes slightly more informative but remains animated as he explains the different types of cleanser. A metallic click or latch sound occurs as he opens a bottle. (7) A rhythmic scrubbing noise against a hard surface is audible during the toilet cleaning segment. The music swells slightly in volume during the before-and-after reveals. (8) The video ends with a final burst of laughter and a light, cheerful ding SFX as the music fades out quickly.
